title: Goodreads reviewer Steve Brock picks Incorruptible as 'Stevo's Business Book of the Week'
summary: Steve Brock, a prolific Goodreads reviewer (675+ reviews), selects Incorruptible as his Business Book of the Week for the week of 5/24, calling it ahead of other recently published books on the topic.
blockquote: I have selected this book as Stevo's Business Book of the Week for the week of 5/24, as it stands heads above other recently published books on this topic.
